row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (quote-only; experience data record pricing in annual tiers, unlimited users)
row.evidence: Medallia's public docs cover SAML/OIDC inbound SSO that can "optionally create or update an account" and a REST Users API, but no SCIM endpoint; part of the Experience Cloud documentation requires a customer login.
row.notes: Quote-only: pricing is an experience data record (EDR) model priced in annual tiers with unlimited users; no list prices. No SCIM endpoint in the public docs.medallia.com Experience Cloud pages (sitemap crawled), the developer portal API index, or the Okta OIN app (SAML and SWA only). Status stays unknown rather than none because Medallia says some product documentation needs a customer login, so a SCIM page could exist out of view. Automation that is documented: SAML JIT (verify, update or create accounts through an Auto Importer specification) and the Users API (/admin/v1/users: list, create, PUT upsert, activate/inactive actions, data-access rules; OAuth client credentials, 1-hour tokens; 70 req/s and 10,000 req/day), available on all Experience Cloud instances. No IdP catalogue app uses the Users API.

plans.name: Medallia Experience Cloud (EDR pricing)
plans.price_text: Contact us to learn more about pricing; priced in annual tiers
plans.notes: Quote-only, unlimited users. SSO and APIs are documented without a plan gate.

scim.notes: No SCIM found in public docs, developer portal or Okta OIN; part of the docs is behind a customer login (c11), so availability is unknown, not false.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 client credentials for an application account; token_type Bearer, expires_in 3600 in the documented example. The application account's role needs the Manage Users permission.

capabilities.notes: User actions are reset-password, activate and inactive. Roles (primary and extra) and data access are set on the user. No DELETE endpoint appears in the reference index.

rate_limits.text: Users API: 70 requests/second, 10,000 requests/day, 180 s timeout; at least 60,000 API calls per 24 hours per instance overall.

okta.notes: OIN app last updated 2015; SAML and SWA checked, no SCIM or provisioning (read from page markup).

entra.notes: No Medallia tutorial in the Entra saas-apps toc.json.

fallbacks.other_sync: Users API bulk download; Auto Importer specification processes SSO assertions
fallbacks.notes: JIT is documented for SAML (create or update accounts via Auto Importer); OIDC inbound SSO is also documented, its JIT behaviour not checked, so jit_protocol 'both' rests on the shared Auto Importer flow only for SAML. docs_public false because part of the docs needs a customer login.
